AUTH_001.description: Bearer token is missing or invalid.
AUTH_001.frontendHandling: Prompt for a valid operator token and retry the request.

VALIDATION_001.description: Request body or query parameters failed schema validation.
VALIDATION_001.frontendHandling: Show field-level validation details when available.

NOT_FOUND_001.description: The requested public route or archive object does not exist.
NOT_FOUND_001.frontendHandling: Show a not-found state and offer navigation back to a valid tab.

RATE_LIMIT_002.description: Request rate exceeded the Worker guardrail.
RATE_LIMIT_002.frontendHandling: Back off and retry after the displayed cooldown.

UPSTREAM_001.description: Fantasy402 or Cloudflare URL Scanner returned an upstream error.
UPSTREAM_001.frontendHandling: Show retry affordance and preserve operator context.

LLM_TIMEOUT.description: An LLM agent did not complete within the configured timeout.
LLM_TIMEOUT.frontendHandling: Allow retry and note that no downstream state was committed.

LLM_INVALID_RESPONSE.message: LLM agent returned an invalid response
LLM_INVALID_RESPONSE.description: Agent output failed the declared response schema.
LLM_INVALID_RESPONSE.frontendHandling: Show agent failure state and log the request id for debugging.
